**What type of PR is this?**

/kind cleanup

**What this PR does / why we need it**:

This is a cleanup of https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/90656.

https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/85127 and https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/90902 point out that we cannot build models for openapiv3 types if x-int-or-string is set. Moving `schema.Unfold()` above `StripValueValidations` lets us strip the anyOf tags that `schema.Unfold()` generates and fixes the invalid schema issue.

issue_context.title: nullable in OpenAPI schema breaks server-side-apply
issue_context.body:
With `nullable: true` in a CRD we get:
```
E1111 19:21:58.602019       1 customresource_handler.go:655] error building openapi models for clusteroperators.config.openshift.io: ERROR $root.definitions.io.openshift.config.v1.ClusterOperator.properties.status.properties.extension has invalid property: nullable
```

This is because gnostic's OpenAPI proto types have no nullable support.

Luckily CRDs keep working because in the upper error case we don't stop serving, just set the SSA schema to nil.
comments:
> This is because gnostic's OpenAPI proto types have no nullable support.

I think it should be "This is because gnostic's OpenAPI **v2** proto types have no nullable support.".
The problem is that we're not supposed to pass-in v3.
OK, We'll write a test and fix this, thanks Stefan!

/reopen

This still happens in slightly different shape:

```
customresource_handler.go:652] error building openapi models for clusterresourcequotas.quota.openshift.io: ERROR $root.definitions.io.openshift.quota.v1.ClusterResourceQuota.properties.spec.properties.quota.properties.hard.additionalProperties.schema has invalid property: anyOf
```

This comes from `x-k-int-or-string`: https://github.com/openshift/api/blob/master/quota/v1/0000_03_quota-openshift_01_clusterresourcequota.crd.yaml#L43
That's a fairly different bug but yes, thanks!

Is this related to the [following blog post](https://kubernetes.io/blog/2019/06/20/crd-structural-schema/) stating that use of "anyOf" wouldn't be allowed after 1.16? We're seeing issue https://github.com/openfaas/faas-netes/issues/630 on OpenFaaS after going to 1.17.5 and 1.18. Usually upgrading K8s versions hasn't caused breaking changes and we're trying to figure out where to start with this one.

> Is this related to the [following blog post](https://kubernetes.io/blog/2019/06/20/crd-structural-schema/) stating that use of "anyOf" wouldn't be allowed after 1.16?

No. That post was about structural schemas. v1 CRDs are limited to structural schemas. v1beta1 CRDs can continue to create non-structural schemas until v1beta1 is no longer served (in 1.22)

Also, `anyOf` is not completely disallowed, specific restrictions inside an `anyOf` clause (like `type`) are what are not allowed ("logical constraints using oneOf, allOf, anyOf, not are allowed").

We could move this to a utility file but I'm not exactly sure where we should put it.

Maybe add a comment that this will add anyOf that needs to be stripped by the line below.
Why was this moved? In order to also skip the value validations coming from unfolding?
Yes. Unfolding adds the `anyOf` tag if x-int-or-string is set. The tag isn't compatible with the v2 schema so we need to strip them via `schema.StripValueValidations()`
